headline: ZoomInfo says it is a flagship data partner for Hunter, Salesforce's new AI agent that does outbound sales work inside Sales Cloud.
score_reason: Company press release; the partnership is claimed by ZoomInfo, with a quote from Salesforce, and no independent assessment.
importance_line: Sales teams using Salesforce get an agent that drafts outreach using outside company data, but the claims come from the companies selling it, and it is unclear how well it performs.
summary: In a Business Wire press release carried by Yahoo Finance, ZoomInfo says it is a flagship data partner for Hunter, Salesforce's new outbound sales agent for Sales Cloud, which uses ZoomInfo data on more than 100 million companies and 500 million contacts to spot target accounts and draft outreach for a salesperson to approve. Rohan Punamia, vice president of product management at Salesforce, is quoted as saying ZoomInfo ships with Hunter out of the box, with no separate contract needed.
notes: VentureBeat page blocked (HTTP 000); read the Business Wire press release on Yahoo Finance and used that link. It is a paid press release from ZoomInfo, so claims are the company's.
